prompts: Help me research the water cycle for my school presentation.
Make pictures of the water cycle for my presentation.
Make a short song to help my class remember it.
Turn these pictures and the song into my presentation video.
research:
Of course! The water cycle is water’s journey around Earth. Here’s a simple explanation for your presentation:

**Evaporation:** The sun warms water in rivers, lakes and oceans, turning it into invisible water vapour.

**Condensation:** As the vapour cools, it forms tiny droplets that gather into clouds.

**Precipitation:** Water falls from clouds as rain or snow.

**Collection:** Water gathers in rivers, lakes and oceans, while some soaks into the ground. Then the journey begins again!

You can remember it as: up, clouds, down, and around!

[Source: USGS Water Science School](https://water.usgs.gov/edu/watercycle-kids-beg.html)
lyrics:
Sunshine warms the water below,
Into the air, the vapour goes.
Cooling makes the cloud drops grow,
Rain falls down; the rivers flow.
Back to lakes and seas again—
The water’s journey has no end.
